notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes a ScpiDriver (family-config, family scpi), but the clone builds every command from parts (the channel index is interpolated: src/wavebench/drivers/dg4202.py:481-527) and each setter reads a snapshot back, so this is a direct Driver over wavebench.drivers.dg4202:DG4202Source with a native.py factory. The repo is a multi-instrument bench toolkit; this package serves its RIGOL DG4202 source (one class of src/wavebench/drivers/, the toolkit's builtin 'rigol.dg4202' instrument), not the whole bench. NOT COVERED: output channel 2 is not served (its state is never read; the e-stop does switch it off); the frequency and amplitude ranges are operator_required (Limit.operator_required; without site-limits.json every write of them is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET, and site-limits.example.json shows an example); the declared duty-cycle limit is the closed 0..100 percent interval while the clone refuses exactly 0 and 100 (dg4202.py:709-711), so those two values pass the envelope and then fail in the native call; offset, phase, frequency mode, sweep state and the APPLy snapshot are read by get_status but not exposed; the arbitrary-waveform upload, the sweep/pulse/modulation features of the clone's services and snapshot/restore are not served (restore_basic_state needs an upstream SourceStatus object, which a package cannot build without importing the clone). The fake is an in-memory stand-in with placeholder values, not a recording: the clone has no simulator for this driver and no hardware was available, so the card's preferred transcript could not be recorded. driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null: the package is model-authored and unreviewed, and nothing in it ran on hardware. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. The DEVIATION FROM THE CARD is accepted: a registry override now makes the card a direct driver. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
